summary: The steps of a flow as one path: markers on a connecting line, done steps checked, the current step the focal point.
whenToUse: Where work stands in a flow with a known order, and who acts next.
Horizontal for two to four short steps; vertical for longer labels or a second line.
whenNotToUse: Location in a hierarchy: use Breadcrumb.
Checks that pass or fail in any order: use Checklist.

dos.title: Timing on a second line
dos.text: One current step. "now, for 3 days" goes in meta, never glued to the label with a dot.

donts.title: Timing glued to the label
donts.text: "Dana decides · now" crams two facts in one line. Put the timing in meta.

accessibility: An ordered list named with label; the current step has aria-current="step".
Done and upcoming steps say so in hidden text: state never rests on color.
Upcoming labels use the muted text color, AA on the default and Harbor surfaces.
contentGuidelines: Who acts and the verb: "Dana decides". Sentence case, no period.
